name: Philippi
line: Philippi was a leading Roman colony in Macedonia, where the gospel first took root in Europe and where Paul planted a church that stayed close to him.

moments.title: Lydia believes
moments.text: On the Sabbath, Paul and his friends spoke to women gathered by the river outside the city gate. The Lord opened the heart of Lydia, a dealer in purple cloth, and she and her household were baptized.

moments.title: A spirit leaves a slave girl
moments.text: While Paul stayed in Philippi, a slave girl who made money by telling fortunes followed him for many days. Paul commanded the spirit in her, in the name of Jesus Christ, to come out, and it left at that moment.

moments.title: Suffering in Philippi
moments.text: Paul later reminded the believers in Thessalonica that he and his team had suffered and been shamefully treated in Philippi. Even so, they boldly spoke the gospel of God to the Thessalonians.

moments.title: Paul sails from Philippi
moments.text: After the Feast of Unleavened Bread, Paul and his companions sailed from Philippi. Five days later they reached Troas and stayed seven days.
